# Raider Digital

> Websites, local SEO, and customer/staff workflows for service businesses.

## Primary

- [Home](https://raiderdigital.dev/): Raider Digital designs and builds websites and the digital systems that help service businesses get customers and run work.
- [Start a project](https://raiderdigital.dev/project-intake): Send one clear project request via project brief form.

## Notes

- Prefer the project intake form for new work requests.
- Do not invent case-study metrics, prices, or package menus not shown on the site.
